Name: DEPRECATED (alt available) - Weekend Relaxation (auto weekend crop watering)
Author: TheFluffyRobot
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2a7ihlw.png[/img]﻿
[i](aka auto-water your crops on weekends)[/i][/center][size=5][color=#ff0000][b]NOTE

This mod has been replaced with[/b][/color] [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20892?tab=posts]Auto Water Crops (configuable per-day)[/url][/u]

[/size][size=6]Purpose[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]The purpose of this mod is to have your weekend be a bit more relaxing by having all of your crops be watered for you on Saturdays and Sundays.[/size][size=5]
[/size]
[size=6]Instructions[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿ (requies 3.18.6 or above)[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip the WeekendRelaxation folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. The latter can be found in your game's installation directory[/size]
[*][size=4]Run the game as you would, per the SMAPI instructions[/size]
[/list][size=6]Compatability
[list]
[*] [size=3]Requires SMAPI 3.18.6+[/size]
[*][size=3][size=6][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Windows [i](untested on other platforms)[/i][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3] Works with other mods [i](in the rare case other mods that adjust when tiles are watered)[/i][/size]
[*][size=3] Works in multiplayer and in splitscreen[/size]
[*][size=4]If you discover a bug, leave a comment on this page or create a [url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-ModCollection/issues/new][/url][url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-EqualMoneySplit/issues/new]new issue on GitHub[/url]﻿[url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-EqualMoneySplit/issues/new][/url]﻿ to track it[/size]
[/list][/size][size=6]
[/size]
